title: FiftyOne — What FiftyOne does
description: FiftyOne by Voxel51 is the open-source toolkit for curating computer-vision datasets: visualize samples, filter by anything, evaluate models, and find the bad labels. It is the workbench where datasets get understood before they get trained on.
